bullets.title: XPT
bullets.note:
I just returned from an incredible week of XPT training in Kaua’i. It combines
breathwork, ice baths, mobility, underwater weightlifting, and more. About 48
hours in, my endurance felt the best it has in years. XPT was created by big-
wave surfer and elite athlete Laird Hamilton
([@LairdLife](http://www.fourhournewsletter.com/click.html?x=a62e&lc=dAz&mc=1&s=bomwH&u=w&y=F&)),
former pro-volleyball player and fitness icon Gabby Reece
([@GabbyReece](http://www.fourhournewsletter.com/click.html?x=a62e&lc=dAB&mc=1&s=bomwH&u=w&y=v&)),
endurance expert Brian Mackenzie
([@brianmackenzie](http://www.fourhournewsletter.com/click.html?x=a62e&lc=dA9&mc=1&s=bomwH&u=w&y=m&)),
former pro-volleyball player Jenn Meredith, and Hollywood powerhouse James
Williams. If you haven’t heard my podcast episode with three of the five,
[it’s a fun
listen](http://www.fourhournewsletter.com/click.html?x=a62e&lc=dAN&mc=1&s=bomwH&u=w&y=O&).
Here are some [upcoming XPT
dates](http://www.fourhournewsletter.com/click.html?x=a62e&lc=dAE&mc=1&s=bomwH&u=w&y=6&);
if you can attend, I recommend it.

bullets.title: OOFOS Ooriginal thong
bullets.note:
Not that kind of thong, you naughty, naughty animal. These flip-flops were
recommended to me by an ultra-endurance runner. Apparently, racers wear these
after competition when they want arch support that still lets their swollen
feet breathe. Stop judging me, [Kelly
Starrett](http://www.fourhournewsletter.com/click.html?x=a62e&lc=dAn&mc=1&s=bomwH&u=w&y=I&)!

bullets.title: Laird Superfood Turmeric Creamer
bullets.note:
XPT consisted of very early mornings, so instant coffee was the order of the
day. I had either
[Instafuel](http://www.fourhournewsletter.com/click.html?x=a62e&lc=dAJ&mc=1&s=bomwH&u=w&y=P&)
or, my favorite, Laird’s turmeric creamer with black coffee. The latter is a
blend of coconut milk powder, turmeric, Aquamin (a mineral-rich calcified sea-
algae), coconut oil, and red-palm oil. This sells as a $2-per-scoop add-on in
local coffee shops.
